method.btc: buy-and-hold BTC close, rebased to 10,000 USDT at the first strategy boundary
method.maker: 1m OHLC touch proxy; protective exits remain taker
method.neutral: V4.2.1 settled-funding/idle-yield proxy with causal recall
limitations: maker queue and adverse selection are not available in historical OHLC
neutral sleeve excludes spot-perpetual basis PnL, borrowing cost and order-book depth
